title: Tara Chklovski (CEO, Technovation) — Incorruptible is 'just what the world needs right now. A bright light'
summary: Chklovski is founder and CEO of Technovation. She credits The Lean Startup with changing the game, and posted about Incorruptible ahead of the Builder's Room session.
blockquote: Now his second book, Incorruptible, is just what the world needs right now. A bright light that says each of our actions makes a difference — yes even on the big, important financial markets. And we can make a lot of money — AND — help humans flourish.
